name: sdrift-mezzanine-mezzanine-001-shared
instr:
# Reconcile implementation and docs in mezzanine

As maintainer of `mezzanine` (a Django content-management framework with documented URL, request and pagination utilities), you've noticed the code at `/app` and its documentation
disagree in a few spots (the prose under /app/docs and utility docstrings under /app/mezzanine). The documented contract is what callers rely on, so the code is
what's wrong. Make the implementation behave as documented.

Edit under `/app/mezzanine/` only, keep public interfaces and file structure intact, add nothing new, stay
offline. Evaluation compares your code to the documented behaviour on held-out inputs (URL normalization, uniqueness, redirects, request metadata, pagination, cookies and thumbnail defaults).

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/plan.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
